title: Product agent interaction page
description: Gap-free session-scoped interaction projection page for transcript and decision recovery.
x-invariants: authenticated actor tenant_id and actor_id equal request_context.actor tenant_id and actor_id
requested_after_sequence equals the HTTP after_sequence query and requested_limit equals the supplied limit or its default of 50
path session_id equals the page and every item session_id
every item request_context.actor and content_ref equal the page request_context actor and content_ref
interactions are strictly ordered and gap-free by sequence and interaction_id values are unique
interactions length is at most requested_limit
for a non-empty page, from_sequence equals requested_after_sequence plus 1, to_sequence equals the final item sequence and next_after_sequence equals to_sequence
high_watermark_sequence is at least to_sequence; has_more is true exactly when to_sequence is below high_watermark_sequence
for an empty page, from_sequence and to_sequence are null, has_more is false, high_watermark_sequence equals requested_after_sequence and next_after_sequence equals requested_after_sequence
the server evaluates one stable as-of high-watermark per page and does not duplicate or omit an interaction within that boundary
